# Infinite Wave

**Infinite Wave** is a mixed reality **survival shooter** that transforms your
real room into a battlefield.

Using Meta Quest’s room setup, your walls, furniture, and space become
part of the game. Take cover behind your couch, move around your table,
and defend your environment against relentless waves of robotic enemies.
